meta.name: Dispatch scenarios for the agentic flow
meta.colour_scheme: red = life-threatening (engine priority emergency); yellow = possible danger or needs a doctor's assessment (engine priority urgent); non-urgent = scheduled transport (engine priority scheduled). Green appears only as the on-scene severity of walking patients in multi-patient incidents.
meta.model: Procedure-first assignment: red -> nearest suitable public unit from any area, private ambulance only if no public unit reaches in 15 min and the private one is faster; yellow -> Ljubljana-area units, other areas only with the demand trigger on and a local wait over 30 min, private only over 45 min [A]; non-urgent -> private vans once the trigger is on; doctor vehicles follow red calls with a doctor flag; one patient per ambulance, so red and yellow patients each need an ambulance.
meta.demand_trigger: free ambulances in the Ljubljana area are 25 percent or less of those crewed, or a red arrival is predicted over 15 minutes [A threshold]
meta.travel: Same constants as backend/app/routing.py: road factor 1.35, 42 km/h, lights and sirens x1.3 for red, weather factor and time-of-day traffic profile copied from the engine; positions interpolate while a unit drives
assumptions: Roster by shift: 26 ambulances crewed in the Ljubljana emergency area by day, 22 by night (decree team counts of 1.5 become 2 by day, 1 by night)
Doctor vehicles: 10 in the Ljubljana area by day, 9 by night; 5 in neighbouring areas
Neighbouring areas used: Kranj, Škofja Loka, Tržič, Litija, Zagorje, Trbovlje, Trebnje, Novo mesto (unit counts rounded from the decree)
Private providers: 3 ambulances with qualified crews (mobilisation 15 min) and 6 non-urgent vans (30 min); bases and crew qualification are not published
Background load: share of units busy with non-urgent transports at the start, 30 percent is the all-day average from 134 interventions a day
Which red calls get a doctor is set by the triage step; the flag is an input here (SloIn NMP text is not public)
Slovenian caller texts are drafts to be read by a native speaker
